cmd:
set -e
export LC_ALL=C.UTF-8
cd /root/Iryna_Karmazina && git fetch -q origin claude/direct-automation-expeditor-671esy
B=origin/claude/direct-automation-expeditor-671esy
git show $B:direct_sync/cosco-track-sync.service > /etc/systemd/system/cosco-track-sync.service
git show $B:direct_sync/cosco-track-sync.timer   > /etc/systemd/system/cosco-track-sync.timer
git show $B:direct_sync/deals_trigger.py > /root/deals_trigger.py
systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl enable --now cosco-track-sync.timer >/dev/null 2>&1
systemctl restart deals-sync-trigger.service
cd /root/direct-sync && timeout 60 /root/unitex-finrep/.venv/bin/python cosco_track_sync.py 2>&1 | tail -4
echo "РОЗКЛАД:"; systemctl list-timers --no-pager | grep -E 'expeditor-direct|maersk-track|cosco-track' | sed 's/  */ /g' | cut -d' ' -f1-3,9
T=$(cat /root/deals-sync-trigger-token)
nohup sh -c "curl -s --max-time 900 'http://127.0.0.1:8788/run?token=$T' > /root/direct-sync/button_test2.json 2>/root/direct-sync/button_test2.err" >/dev/null 2>&1 &
echo "тест кнопки запущено (перевіримо наступною командою)"
